rv.q: It is one that recognises the absurdity of the situation without diminishing the role of a life-saving charity.
Still, this is a confident and adventurous debut from Mould, with a rich seam of humorous, relatable dialogue.
"The Brenda Line" is at its heart a "sweet comedy about acceptance and making all of us feel human".

cn.t: Critics find Harry Mould's debut a warm, thoughtful two-hander exploring a curious Samaritans policy. Consistently praised for its humanity and humor, though some feel it doesn't fully probe its provocative premise.
